response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states the presence of 'bilateral breast nodules suggestive of fibroadenomas', 'Global loss of expression of FH', and a 'pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)', all of which are direct support items for Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer (HLRCC) syndrome (D3). Candidate D1, Ovarian Fibroma, is contradicted by the histopathology findings of a 'Spindle cell tumor composed of elongated cells arranged in long sweeping to poorly formed fascicles', which is not characteristic of an ovarian fibroma.
